title: Strictness is the coincidence of the quotient filtration with the induced filtration
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file homology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that a morphism of filtered objects is strict exactly when the canonical morphism from its coimage to its image is an isomorphism of filtered objects (statement lines 4968-4979). The proof is a complete argument: the canonical morphism is already an isomorphism of the underlying objects, and the filtrations on the coimage and on the image are identified as the quotient filtration coming from the source and the induced filtration coming from the target, after which the equivalence follows from the definition of strictness (proof lines 4982-4992). The non-formal content is the identification of the two filtrations. The claim is H2: a structured argument with each input named.
